title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
content: We deliver countrywide via trusted couriers. Orders placed before 2:00 PM are dispatched the same business day within Nairobi. Nairobi delivery: 1 business day. Countrywide: 1-3 business days via G4S/Wells Fargo/matatu SACCO parcel as agreed. Delivery fees are calculated at checkout by location. Tracking details are shared by SMS/WhatsApp after dispatch. Contact +254 708 777192 for delays.

title: Returns & Refund Policy
content: You may return an unused item in its original packaging within 7 days of delivery. Faulty or wrongly-supplied items are replaced or fully refunded at our cost. To start a return, call +254 708 777192 or email info@powertoolsplugke.co.ke with your order number. Approved refunds are processed to the original M-Pesa/payment method within 3-5 business days. Return shipping for change-of-mind is paid by the buyer; for faulty items it is paid by us. Some hygiene/consumable items are non-returnable once opened.

title: Privacy Policy
content: We collect your name, phone, email and delivery address solely to process and deliver orders and to provide support. We do not sell your data. Payment is handled by M-Pesa and our payment providers; we do not store card details. You may request access to or deletion of your data by emailing info@powertoolsplugke.co.ke. This policy is specific to Power Tools Plug Kenya.

title: Terms & Conditions
content: By ordering from Power Tools Plug you agree to these terms. Prices are in Kenyan Shillings (KES) and include applicable taxes unless stated. Payment methods: M-Pesa, bank transfer, and cash/pay-on-delivery where available. Warranty terms follow each manufacturer's policy. Disputes are governed by the laws of Kenya. Contact: Magomano House, Tom Mboya Street, Nairobi; +254 708 777192.

title: FAQs
content:
Are your tools genuine? Yes, we source only from reputable manufacturers and distributors.

Do you deliver countrywide? Yes, 1-3 business days.

What payments do you accept? M-Pesa, bank transfer and pay-on-delivery.

Do tools have warranty? Yes, per manufacturer warranty.
